# Support

Use GitHub issues for reproducible bugs and focused feature requests. Before opening one, check [SETUP.md](SETUP.md), existing issues, and the [contribution guide](CONTRIBUTING.md).

For a useful report, include:

- Eko version or commit.
- Desktop operating system.
- Android model and Android version, if involved.
- Whether the desktop and receiver were on the same network.
- The exact steps that failed.
- A short, redacted log or error message.

Do not include credentials, tokens, private keys, pairing links, personal data, IP history, or raw audio. Use the [security policy](SECURITY.md) for suspected vulnerabilities.

Eko is maintained by a small community. Support is best effort, and real-device or platform-specific issues may need a minimal reproduction before they can be investigated.
